title: České školní prázdniny (multijazyčné, openpotato/OpenHolidays)
description: School-vacation periods (školní prázdniny) of the Czech Republic as published by the OpenHolidays API and seeded from the openpotato/openholidaysapi.data monorepo. Each record describes a single vacation window with start/end dates, duration in days, regional scope (which Czech kraje the vacation applies to), and parallel names in Czech (default), German, and English. Per-kraj resolution captured in `subdivision_codes` (joinable to cs-kraje-okresy-iso via ShortName). Distinct vacation stems: Vánoční prázdniny (Christmas), Pololetní prázdniny (Half-term), Jarní prázdniny (Spring), Velikonoční prázdniny (Easter), Hlavní prázdniny (Summer), Podzimní prázdniny (Autumn). Spring vacation rotates weekly across CZ regions on a 6-week cycle, hence the bulk of Regional-scope entries. Some regional Praha rows carry CS/DE/EN/FR comments distinguishing Praha 1–5 vs Praha 6–10. First cs-skolni-* dataset in the project (no pre-existing slug).
